# ScramServerSound

*Server*

A sound that can be changed while it plays: moved, faded, made higher or lower, paused, stopped with a fade-out, and heard from the right point by players who come later (see [`sync()`](#sync)). Create it with

`world.createSound(sound)` (at a world position) or `entity.createSound(sound)` (following the entity), set it up and call [`play()`](#play). Changes are sent to the players who hear it once at the end of the server tick. Find a playing sound from another script with `c.getServer().getSound(id)`. Call methods on the server thread (server scripts and schedules run there).

```js
var music = c.getWorld().createSound("arena_music", "minecraft:music.creative")
    .setPosition(0, 64, 0)
    .setRange(48)
    .setLooping(true)
    .setVolume(0)
    .play();

music.fadeTo(1, 40);
// later, from any script
c.getServer().getSound("arena_music").stop(60);
```

## Methods

### getServerSound {#getserversound}

::: member

**Returns** `ServerSound` — the internal server sound; changes made through it bypass the validation of this wrapper

:::

### getId {#getid}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — sound ID: the one given on creation, or a random UUID

:::

### getSound {#getsound}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — sound event ID, like `"minecraft:music.creative"`

:::

### play {#play}

::: member

Starts the sound for every player who should hear it. A playing sound with the same ID stops at once. Does nothing if this sound already plays.

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### stop {#stop}

::: member

Stops the sound at once. Does nothing if it does not play.

:::

### stop {#stop-2}

::: member

Fades the sound out, then stops it.

```js
c.getServer().getSound("arena_music").stop(60); // 3 seconds
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fadeTicks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | length of the fade-out in ticks; 0 or less stops at once |

:::

### isPlaying {#isplaying}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the sound plays: started, neither stopped nor ended; a paused sound plays too

:::

### pause {#pause}

::: member

Pauses the sound for everybody; [`resume()`](#resume) continues from the same point.

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### resume {#resume}

::: member

Continues a paused sound from the point it was paused at.

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### isPaused {#ispaused}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the sound is paused

:::

### seek {#seek}

::: member

Jumps to a point of the sound file, for everybody who hears it.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | time from the start of the file in ticks (20 ticks are a second) |

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### getTime {#gettime}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — ticks played in the sound file: faster with a higher pitch, standing still while paused

:::

### getLength {#getlength}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — length of the sound file in ticks, set by [`setLength(int)`](#setlength) or reported by a client that played it; -1 while unknown

:::

### setLength {#setlength}

::: member

Tells the length of the sound file, which the server does not have; without it, a sound that does not loop ends when a client reports the length, or after 30 minutes. Players who come too late then do not hear it.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | length of the sound file in ticks; -1 for unknown |

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### sync {#sync}

::: member

Players who start hearing the sound after it started (joined, came closer, changed dimension) hear it from the point it has reached, as if they heard it from the start. This is the default.

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### restart {#restart}

::: member

Players who start hearing the sound after it started hear it from the beginning. The sound still ends for everybody when it ends on the server.

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### skip {#skip}

::: member

Only players who heard the start hear the sound; others never do. Good for short effects that sound wrong from the middle.

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### setMinRemaining {#setminremaining}

::: member

With [`sync()`](#sync), a player who comes later does not start a sound that does not loop if less than this is left of it; needs a known length, see [`setLength(int)`](#setlength).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | shortest rest of the sound to start, in ticks |

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### setPosition {#setposition}

::: member

Places the sound at a world position; a following sound stops following its entity.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### moveTo {#moveto}

::: member

Smoothly moves the sound to a world position; a following sound stops following its entity.

```js
sound.moveTo("sine_inout", 100, 20, 64, 0);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `interpolation` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | BBS interpolation name, like `"linear"`; unknown names are linear |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in ticks; 0 or less moves at once |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | target x |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | target y |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | target z |

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### getPosition {#getposition}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector with the current position of the sound; for a following sound, its entity's position plus the offset

:::

### attach {#attach}

::: member

Makes the sound follow an entity, at its feet. If the entity is removed, the sound stays where it was.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `entity` | `ScriptServerEntity<?>` | entity to follow, not null |

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### attach {#attach-2}

::: member

Makes the sound follow an entity with an offset from its feet.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `entity` | `ScriptServerEntity<?>` | entity to follow, not null |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset along x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset along y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset along z in blocks |

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### detach {#detach}

::: member

Stops following the entity; the sound stays where the entity is now.

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### setGlobal {#setglobal}

::: member

Makes the sound heard at the same volume everywhere in its dimension, without a position, like music; or puts it back at its position.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isGlobal` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the sound has no position |

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### isGlobal {#isglobal}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the sound is heard everywhere in its dimension

:::

### setRange {#setrange}

::: member

Sets how far the sound is heard: it gets quieter with the distance and is silent at the range. Players farther away do not get the sound at all.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `blocks` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | range in blocks; 16 by default |

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### getRange {#getrange}

::: member

**Returns** [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) — range in blocks

:::

### setVolume {#setvolume}

::: member

Sets the volume at once.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `volume` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | volume, 0 (silent) to 1 (full); limited to them |

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

Smoothly changes the volume with an interpolation.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `volume` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | target volume, 0 to 1 |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in ticks; 0 or less changes at once |

### getVolume {#getvolume}

### setPitch {#setpitch}

| --- | --- | --- |
| `pitch` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | pitch, 0.5 (octave lower, half speed) to 2 (octave higher, double speed); limited to them |

:::

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

::: member

Smoothly changes the pitch with an interpolation.

| --- | --- | --- |

| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in ticks; 0 or less changes at once |

### setCategory {#setcategory}

::: member

Sets the category whose volume slider in the sound options controls the sound.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | master, music, record, weather, block, hostile, neutral, player, ambient or voice; master by default |

### addListener {#addlistener}

::: member

Makes the sound private: only the added players hear it. While no player is added, everybody near hears it.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `player` | [`ScriptServerPlayer`](/scripting/server/entity/ScriptServerPlayer) | player who hears the sound, not null |

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### removeListener {#removelistener}

::: member

Takes a player off the private listeners; the sound stops for that player at the next check.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `player` | [`ScriptServerPlayer`](/scripting/server/entity/ScriptServerPlayer) | player to remove, or null to do nothing |

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::

### clearListeners {#clearlisteners}

::: member

Makes the sound heard by everybody near again.

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — this sound

:::
